code: import{useCallback,useEffect,useMemo}from"react";import{useDispatch}from"react-redux";import{useForm}from"react-hook-form";import{useState}from"react";import{showSuccessToast}from"common/ToastMessage";import CommonMessage from"common/CommonMessage";import{createMainBusinessCategory,getMainBusinessCategories,updateMainBusinessCategory}from"modules/administration/slices/mainbusinesscategorySlice";const useMainBusinessCategoryForm=()=>{const dispatch=useDispatch();const[createModalOpen,setCreateModalOpen]=useState(false);const[editValues,setEditValues]=useState([]);const{control,reset,handleSubmit}=useForm({});useEffect(()=>{reset({...editValues});},[reset,editValues]);const onSubmit=useCallback(async(body,editFlag)=>{try{if(editFlag){await dispatch(updateMainBusinessCategory({id:editValues===null||editValues===void 0?void 0:editValues.uuid,newData:body})).unwrap();showSuccessToast(CommonMessage.MFS00003.replace("%s","Main Business Category"));}else{await dispatch(createMainBusinessCategory({...body})).unwrap();showSuccessToast(CommonMessage.MFS00001.replace("%s","Main Business Category"));}reset();setEditValues("");setCreateModalOpen(false);await dispatch(getMainBusinessCategories());}catch(error){console.error("Error",error);}},[dispatch,reset,editValues]);return useMemo(()=>({control,onSubmit,handleSubmit,createModalOpen,setCreateModalOpen:value=>setCreateModalOpen(value),setEditValues:value=>setEditValues(value),editValues}),[control,onSubmit,handleSubmit,createModalOpen,editValues]);};export default useMainBusinessCategoryForm;
